mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is positive in >50% of 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals economic weakness and potential earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has positive coefficient in regression or joint decline fails to predict negative returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals severe supply contraction, reducing corporate output and increasing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as predictor of 5-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is negative in >50% of 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300 (1982-1984=100), it signals persistently high inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decline in FEDFUNDS indicates stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has positive coefficient in regression or joint condition fails to predict negative returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals housing market downturn, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.
